method: Production parser functions from both module scripts

scenarios.scenario: Subject stops before unlabeled body prose
Wrapped labels, recipients, subject and series remain exact
Unambiguous numeric, abbreviated and leap dates validate
Dates in body text are never used as the issue date
Letter references never classify as memorandum
Later page references cannot replace first-page fields
Full-width labels and common heading OCR errors parse safely
Inline PDF columns split into their own labeled fields
Missing fields remain empty instead of fabricated defaults
Dashboard months handle year changes without timezone shifts
